claims.claim_text: Section 3(23) defines the Certificate of Registration as showing registration as an architect after passing the LEA.
Section 3(37) defines the PIC as bearing registration number, issuance date, and expiry date and being due for periodic renewal.
Section 7(c)-(d) gives the Board authority to administer oaths and issue, suspend, revoke, or reinstate CORs and PICs.
Section 17 requires successful candidates to take the professional oath before entering practice.
Section 18 states the COR remains effective until withdrawn, suspended, or revoked and uses a three-year PIC fee/renewal cycle.
